protected_contracts.name: analytics_reporting_export
rules: Analytics visible metrics and CSV export must use the same normalized top filter set.
Date Range, Organization Type, Specific Organization, and Voucher Type filters must apply consistently across Analytics sections.
Denied/Blocked vouchers must be included in overview and export populations unless a future explicit status filter changes that contract.
Analytics reporting must remain read-only and must not mutate voucher, fulfillment, invoice, statement, or accounting batch state.

protected_contracts.name: voucher_identity
rules: Neighbor identity fields must remain traceable.
DOB changes must be audited in future correction workflows.
Original values must not be silently overwritten by privileged corrections.

protected_contracts.name: voucher_eligibility
rules: 90-day eligibility behavior is protected.
Eligibility override behavior must be explicit and audited.
Eligibility changes must not erase original voucher history.

protected_contracts.name: voucher_expiration
rules: 30-day redemption expiration behavior is protected.
Expiration correction must be explicit and audited.
Expired-to-active transitions must require override authority.

protected_contracts.name: voucher_correction_authority
rules: Voucher corrections must require explicit authority.
Future correction workflows must preserve original values.
Correction authority must be auditable and separate from ordinary cashier mutation.

protected_contracts.name: manager_override_authority
rules: Override code authority is separate from the logged-in operator identity.
Override codes must be hashed when redesigned.
Override use must capture both logged-in user and manager authority.
Override validation must create audit entry for both success and failure.

protected_contracts.name: audit_logging
rules: Protected mutation must create a human-readable audit event.
Audit events must include before, after, actor, override authority when applicable, reason, and timestamp.
Audit logs must be understandable without reading raw JSON.

protected_contracts.name: furniture_catalog_data
rules: Catalog item changes must preserve request-form stability.
Future catalog multi-user editing must include conflict handling.
Catalog edits must be audited.

protected_contracts.name: pricing_calculation_display
rules: Maximum Conference commitment language is protected.
User-facing pricing must not reintroduce 'may vary' language.
Invoice generation must use actual fulfilled prices where applicable.

protected_contracts.name: receipt_invoice_generation
rules: Neighbor receipt must not show prices.
Conference invoice must preserve financial integrity.
Generated document links must remain tied to completed vouchers.

protected_contracts.name: delivery_address_verification
rules: Unverified delivery address must warn but not block.
Delivery verification must not introduce dispatch or routing logic.
Delivery attempts and RouteShyft behavior remain out of scope.

protected_contracts.name: release_c_request_group_creation
rules: Release C builder submissions must create one request group and one to three child vouchers atomically.
A request group may include no more than one child voucher of each root voucher type.
Historical vouchers may remain without a request group and must remain viewable.
Legacy `household` voucher values must not be reinterpreted as `household_goods`.

protected_contracts.name: release_c_household_goods_catalog
rules: Household Goods is a distinct root voucher type, not Furniture and not a Furniture catalog category.
Household Goods browse groups and catalog categories must be administratively editable by authorized users.
Furniture and Household Goods priced catalog entries support fixed or range retail pricing and maximum organization coverage.
Household Goods selected-category and total-quantity limits are configurable non-negative integers where zero means unlimited.
Issued Household Goods request lines must snapshot catalog values needed for historical display, reporting, receipts, invoices, and audit.
Household Goods catalog behavior must not add unrestricted request Notes or item-level fulfillment Notes.

protected_contracts.name: release_c_delivery_snapshots
rules: Delivery availability is configured by voucher type and affects future requests only.
Delivery is recorded once per request group when selected.
Issued request groups must snapshot delivery eligibility, selection, address, verification data, and fee.
Delivery changes must not add dispatch, routing, driver scheduling, delivery calendar, multiple delivery attempts, or RouteShyft behavior.

protected_contracts.name: release_c_fulfillment_entries
rules: New Release C Furniture and Household Goods vouchers use requested lines and fulfillment entries for one-screen cashier fulfillment.
Finalization must require every requested line to resolve requested quantity through fulfilled quantities plus unavailable quantity.
Fulfillment rows must preserve actor, timestamp, actual unit price, fulfilled quantity, and calculated line total.
Historical Furniture fulfillment data must remain valid and must not be destructively rewritten.

protected_contracts.name: release_c_finalization_notes
rules: Release C permits only one optional internal voucher-level finalization note for Furniture and Household Goods.
The finalization note is cashier or manager entered, internal-only, and stored with author and timestamp.
The finalization note must not print on neighbor receipts or Conference or Partner invoices.
No unrestricted Vincentian Notes or item-level fulfillment Notes may be introduced.

protected_contracts.name: release_c_receipt_invoice_behavior
rules: Neighbor-facing receipts must not show prices, reimbursement values, internal guidance, unavailable internal details, or finalization notes.
Conference or Partner billing records use actual fulfilled values and include the group-level delivery fee once when applicable.
Receipt and invoice behavior must preserve legacy Clothing and Furniture records.
Household Goods estimates are request-time projections; final financial documents use actual fulfillment entries.

protected_contracts.name: release_c_cashier_card_status
rules: Cashier-facing primary card labels are READY TO REDEEM, REDEEMED, and EXPIRED.
Furniture and Household Goods fulfillment progress may appear inside the voucher detail screen without replacing the primary card labels.
Cashier card status precedence must keep redeemed status above expired status.
Cashier status display changes must preserve existing card architecture and must not convert the cashier station into a table.

protected_contracts.name: monthly_accounting_exports
rules: Monthly statement and export retries must not duplicate invoice assignments, export ownership, or successful deliveries.
QuickBooks exports must reuse stored invoice identity and totals.
Accounting mutations require svdp_manage_accounting and readable audit history.
Existing statements and invoices must remain preserved through additive migration.

protected_contracts.name: neighbor_voucher_print
rules: Neighbor voucher printing requires authenticated cashier authority and a valid nonce.
Printed approved items use issued request snapshots rather than current catalogs or fulfillment outcomes.
The print DTO and template must omit all pricing, invoice, fee, coverage, override, and internal-note fields.
Printing must be auditable without retaining rendered neighbor contact information.
